# AbstractAgent

> Agent patterns (ReAct / CodeAct / MemAct) built on AbstractRuntime (durable workflows + storage/ledger) and AbstractCore (providers + tool schemas).

This repository contains the `abstractagent` Python package (a library; no interactive UI).
Use this file as a curated “map” for LLM/agent consumption. For a deeper index (more source files + tests), see `llms-full.txt`.

Important notes (source-of-truth hints):
- Docs entrypoint: `README.md` → `docs/getting-started.md` → `docs/README.md`
- Runtime behavior lives in workflow adapters: `src/abstractagent/adapters/*_runtime.py`
- Prompting/parsing logic stays runtime-agnostic: `src/abstractagent/logic/*` (no `abstractruntime` imports)
- `src/abstractagent/adapters/generation_params.py` is the shared LLM param normalizer for temperature, seed, media policy, prompt-cache identity, streaming passthrough, and Core `thinking`.
- `src/abstractagent/adapters/loop_hooks.py` is the shared loop-hook layer (listen/steer/capture); see `docs/hooks.md`.
- MemAct is not re-exported at the package top-level; import from `abstractagent.agents.memact` (see `docs/api.md`).
- After changes, run tests: `pytest -q`

## Ecosystem

- [AbstractFramework](https://github.com/lpalbou/AbstractFramework): ecosystem overview
- [AbstractCore](https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractcore): providers + tool schemas
- [AbstractRuntime](https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractruntime): durable workflows + storage/ledger

## Code entry points

- [Public API](src/abstractagent/__init__.py): Exported symbols
- [Agents package](src/abstractagent/agents/__init__.py): Agent factories + classes
- [BaseAgent](src/abstractagent/agents/base.py): start/step/resume/attach/save_state/get_ledger
- [ReAct workflow](src/abstractagent/adapters/react_runtime.py): `create_react_workflow(...)`
- [CodeAct workflow](src/abstractagent/adapters/codeact_runtime.py): `create_codeact_workflow(...)`
- [MemAct workflow](src/abstractagent/adapters/memact_runtime.py): `create_memact_workflow(...)`
- [Built-in tool schemas](src/abstractagent/logic/builtins.py): schema-only tool definitions (adapter-mapped + runtime-owned; incl. `read_skill`)
- [Default tools bundle](src/abstractagent/tools/__init__.py): `ALL_TOOLS`
- [Task reset](src/abstractagent/agents/task_reset.py): `reset_react_task(vars, task)` — between-runs vars transform for queued work (per-task state resets; door-owned state persists)
- [Unattended recipe](src/abstractagent/agents/unattended.py): `unattended_runtime_overrides` (no `ask_user`, no-questions directive)

## Tests

- [Test suite](tests/): `pytest` tests for workflows and agent behavior

- [Manual demo](manual_agent_demo.py): Minimal local demo (requires a working provider)
